prompt: Rewrite snippets/comparison-table-rows.liquid so that it renders the body rows of a product comparison table. The snippet must trim whitespace as described below. Inputs. All inputs are top-level variables and are always supplied: - `highlight`: string or null. - `rows`: array or null. Each element is an object that always has the keys `label` and `values`. - `label`: string or null. - `values`: string or null. It holds a comma-separated list of cell values. Trimming means removing leading and trailing whitespace, the same as the `strip` filter. A null value trims to "". Rules: 1. Labels: - Trim each row's `label`. - If the trimmed label is "", skip the row entirely. This includes null labels and whitespace-only labels. 2. Row markup: each kept row, in input order, is `LABELCELLS`. LABEL is the trimmed, HTML-escaped label. 3. Highlighting: - Trim `highlight`. - If the trimmed highlight is not "" and it equals the trimmed label exactly (case-sensitive), the opening tag becomes ``. 4. Cells: trim the whole `values` string first. - If the result is "" (including when `values` is null), CELLS is exactly `n/a`. - Otherwise, split the result on "," using Liquid `split` semantics. Trim each segment. - A segment that is "" after trimming becomes `n/a`. - Any other segment becomes `VALUE`, where VALUE is the trimmed, HTML-escaped segment. - Keep segments in order. 5. Wrapper: - If at least one row is kept, wrap all rows in `...`. - If no row is kept (including when `rows` is null or empty), output nothing (an empty string). There must be no whitespace or newlines anywhere between tags in the output. Use the standard `escape` filter for HTML escaping. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/comparison-table-rows.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
